## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.0
**Improvements** - **Active Window Highlight** — the outline now stays locked to the window while you move or resize it (including dragging the title bar sideways and resizing down to the minimum size), no longer lags or drifts, and hides while Mission Control is open. - **Audio Mixer** — System Audio Recording is now shown in the Permissions overview and the Audio Mixer settings, and declining it no longer stops your audio. Audio from websites and browser tabs is grouped under the owning app (e.g. "Google Chrome"), and the menu updates live as audio starts and stops. - **Pointer profiles** — more reliable detection of the mouse you're actually using, so the active device is selected automatically. - **Menu polish** — feature toggles (Wi-Fi auto-switch, Auto Blackout, Mirroring, Active Window Highlight, Audio Mixer) keep the menu open when switched, the Permissions button is color-coded by how many permissions are granted, and keyboard-shortcut hints line up cleanly.
